reviews.title: Scam artists
reviews.text: I have experienced the same scam Sunwing seems to pull on many of its clients. See they offer an early flight for an extra charge and then they cancel the early flight and put everyone on the later one but they never reimburse the cost of the early flight. Many have posted about this scam which Sunwing pulls on people. Also never ever buy from their reps on-site. Twice now I was sold a package fraudulently. Once they sold me a package with 4 sites of which one was snorkeling with turtles. The operator told me they never swim with turtles and Sunwing never reimbursed me. Then they sold me another package with port fees to be paid at the operator. The fee was supposed to be $10 it turned out to be over $100 and had to be paid cash. Again no reimbursement. They only care about making the commission from the sale and then could not care less that what they sold you was not what you got. Be weary of these people.
reviews.author: Rene C

reviews.title: Trip literally Flew By
reviews.text: Flight from Toronto to Cancun and flight back to TO was seemless. Very fast. We even got in early coming back. Too bad we got screened both ways which was odd!!! We did have to make some calls to Sunwing when we noticed our upgraded seats that we had proof of booking ended up going to someone else, but my husband really wanted the priority check-in and priority boarding - good thing he made sure to check status of our seats and called it out. Otherwise a pleasant & fast plane ride both ways.
reviews.author: DonnaToronto1

reviews.title: Bad experience with sunwing recommendation
reviews.text: Sunwing made a very bad hotel recommendation! The hotel we reserved at was recommended by sunwing its a 4.5 stars. Long story short sunwing you ruined my vacation and embarrassed me in front of my son and mother roc arenas doradas hotel in cuba varadero does not deserve to be called a hotel call it whatever you want but not a hotel. Cleanliness bad service bad food bad pool bad In brief (shame on you sunwing shame on you roc arenas doradas) Sunwing i Will never forgive you for ruining my vacation you doing marketing for a resort that is bad and you know it just because you are benefiting as a company financially does not give you the right to misguide people that have good intentions and all they want is to enjoy their vacation days and relax. Will never fly with sunwing and will let everyone know about it. Photos of the recommended hotel including reptiles inside the room attached.
reviews.author: Hassan Al khalidi

reviews.title: Horrible customer service and downright scam
reviews.text: Sunwing had 2 flights going to Cancun. One at 11h and one at 9h. It charged and extra $50 for the 9am flight. Then a month before we fly they cancelled the 9am flight but never refunded me the extra $50 they charged for an early flight. So basically they charged a bunch of people an extra $50 and then denied the service and never reimbursed the cost. Then, in cancun, their representative sells us an excursion. It had costs for harbour fees. Now anyone would expect the harbour fees to be per boat at the very least. But the rep assured me this was not so. It was a one cost for the whole group payable at the excursion site. Guess what? Once at the site the operators tell us that the cost is per person. So basically the rep lied to us so we would buy his trip and he can make his cut. Once miles away at the operator we were left to have to deal with an extra $150 cost which had to be paid in cash, no credit card. So I write to Sunwing and it takes them 5 months to send me a form letter that basically tells me they are not responsible for the operators of the excursion and that changes in schedule happen all the time and basically tough crap I’m not getting any customer service. Except it’s not just a change in schedule is it? They charged extra for the earlier flight and the operators are not the ones who lied to me about the price to any were they? Sunwing was responsible for both. This company has gone downhill very fast over that last couple of years. They used to be one of the best but now I’d rather fly any other company, knowing that Sunwing are thieves and scammers. All I asked was the $50 back and an apology for the extra costs at the excursion. All I got was some bs 5 months after the fact.
reviews.author: Rene C

reviews.author: Jen A

reviews.title: DELAYED FOR 15+ HOURS
reviews.text: I was ready to leave my resort at 8am when 15 minutes before my bus picked me up to drop me off at the airport I got a notification from Sunwing that my flight was delayed by a couple of hours. A bit frustrated but no big deal. Then throughout the day I kept getting more emails telling me further on that my flight keeps getting delayed to the point where it’s been almost 15 hours. This is the worst flight experience I have ever had in my entire life. Please please please I AM BEGGING to whoever reads this. Just choose the better slightly more expensive airline. It will be worth it. Under any circumstances do not fly with Sunwing. They will leave you rotting at the airport for 1-2 days And won’t offer ANY compensation unless you FIGHT THEM FOR IT. utterly the worst airline in the entire planet. The seats are too small and crammed, the airplanes don’t look safe, the food on the airplane is horrible. The staff are not nice or welcoming at all. You will be EXTREMELY LUCKY to get your flight on time. This company is known for its super long delays, horrible service, no compensation offered. Overall if you see a vacation package slightly more expensive then Sunwing, jus pay the goddamn money. Trust me you do not wanna go through what Sunwing will put you through. I am here at the airport in Punta cana where some people have been for 2 DAYS waiting for the Sunwing airlines to come take them home. Truly the most disgusting and unprofessional airline of all time. Legit ruined my vacation. Please do yourself and your family and friends and anyone you know a HUGE FAVOR and DO NOT FLY WITH SUNWING UNDER ANY CIRCUMSTANCES. YOU WILL GET STRANDED.

reviews.title: Do not book vacation trips with Sunwing

Had so many issues. Contacted Hotel and Sunwing while at the resort and again after coming back. Nothing was done to resolve the issue. The case is still opened with Sunwing and last message received was that Sunwing is still working on it even after 4 months. So terrible customer service and support. It's not a brand. Stay away.

She finally got me a cup of water from 'the sink'. I doubt it was from the sink, more likely from a 2l bottle of water they were making instant coffee from. From the lineup at the airport, to arriving at destination, service was lacking. If you can use any other airline, aside from sunwing, do it. Its the absolute worst.

reviews.title: WORST EXPERIENCE EVER “Don’t do it”
reviews.text: Don’t waste your time or money! My reservation was done and my partner at the time got Covid. I tried to change my plans and was forced to take part of the trip myself, so I don’t lose all my money fast forward to today. I’m trying to change the date on my partners itinerary and no one is willing to help, when you called them and asked to speak to someone because no one can really give you an answer other than what is showing on their screen.. all I wanted to be made clear is the booking date and the travel date so I can make the changes. The lady helping gives me three different answers, when I ask for a supervisor the supervisor or manager is refusing to take the call, w/no reason even if you have a booking with them and confirmation stating that everything was done through them don’t waste your time or money.
reviews.author: Marie

reviews.title: Bag returned within 18 hours!
reviews.text: We had a great experience with Sunwing! Despite all of the poor reviews we personally feel that Sunwing holds themselves accountable if you put in the effort as well. Upon arrival in Toronto, we were assisted through every step of checking in, security, etc. Boarding the plane was smooth and the flight was quick and enjoyable. In Cancun, we experienced some stress as one of our 3 bags did not arrive. Out of everyone on our flight, a total of 3 bags had been lost. Right away we were able to speak to 2 Sunwing representatives in person who helped us fill out a form to get our bag back. The same happened for the other 2 people who had lost their bag. The representatives were kind, helpful, and were adament that the bag would come the next day. The bus from the airport to our hotel had to wait for us and did not leave until we were onboard. Even the representative on the bus was positive that the bag would show up the next day! Keep in mind that our flight landed around 9pm. The next day, we called Toronto about my bag and they informed us that it was currently on a flight to Cancun - the first flight that morning, and that it would arrive at our hotel by that night. Sure enough, the bag arrived that afternoon! So in just 18 hours Sunwing had reunited us with the bag! Of course in the moment we were upset, but we feel that because we put in the work to get updates about the bag, Sunwing was very reassuring and did a fantastic job at getting the bag back to us extremely quickly. We have no complaints! Our flight home was smooth as well and we really enjoyed our vacation!
reviews.author: Lara F

reviews.title: Waste time and money
reviews.text: 1 star is too much for them. Worst customer service ever! I have paid 2 times for their own mistakes and wring information
reviews.author: Mahsa M

reviews.title: 2* rating only because of the vacation package provided
reviews.text: We were looking for a last minute vacation deal and Sunwing Vacations offered a deal we could not pass up - if this was the only factor we would give them a 5* review but you need to fly to get there and I rate that a 1*. When we booked the vacation we fully realized that Sunwing AIrlines had become a low cost carrier and very little is included in their flight services - water, tea and coffee that is it. We didn't have a problem with this, the problem arose with the lack of communications that the airline provided. Leaving Calgary the Sunwing communications was great and we received numerous alerts alerting us to the flight status. While in Mexico we received 0 even with the airline having a variety of ways to contact us. When we got to the airport, I checked their app again only to find out that the flight was going to be delayed 50 minutes. This 50 minutes actually turned out to be 90 minutes. At no time did Sunwing airport personnel advise that their was going to be delayed. Our boarding passes still indicated the normal boarding time even though by the time we got checked in I already new that the flight was going to be delayed. Our boarding passes indicate we would be boarding on gate A but there are 9 gates in this section and only got advised of the actual gate about 90 minutes before the flight was to initally depart. The gate agents stood at the gate for well over an hour before they made an announcement that the flight was going to be delayed. Only after we were on the plane and in the air did the pilot announce that area thunderstoms created the delay. This information could have easily been provided to the guest waiting to board the plane. I realize this is not the first review that describes the very poor communication from Sunwing and I expect it will not be the last. It has been 10 years since we last flew with Sunwing and it will be the last as I hope that Westjet makes major changes on how this airline functions in the very near future.
reviews.author: Calgarysuntraveller

reviews.title: LUGGAGE LOST FOR 4 DAYS - THIRD TIME WITH SUNWING
reviews.text: Sunwing Care Support - pointless department to have, nobody responds to emails. 1. Sunwing responded to refunding my costs for luggage being lost and would be done through an e-transfer to my email in 6 weeks. It is now 10 weeks, no etransfer, no response on the status. 2. Someone names Xavier emailed me May 16, 2023 request a copy of my receipts (sent to Sunwing April 12, 2023). Emailed him back and to date no response or acknowledgement he received the receipts. 3. SUNWING - PLEASE DON'T BOTHER HAVING YOUR CUSTOMERS CONTACT A CARE SUPPORT SYSTEM WHEN THEY CANNOT HAVE THE COURTESY TO RETURN AN EMAIL RESPONSE WITHIN A WEEK. 4. Simply said - it is so sad that service does not exist anymore. In this day and age where information is sent like a speed of lightning - and yet we cannot get this resolved in a more timely basis. 5. Sunwing was sold to Westjet......even worse...... 6. We are constant victims when flying - delays happen, luggage lost, terrible service, no service - do it yourself, rude people who want to stand around and talk about their problems. FINAL - WHY BOTHER HAVING AN EMAIL - JUST IGNORE PEOPLE - PUT THEM ON HOLD FOR OVER AN HOUR AND EVENTUALLY YOU HANG UP.....THIS IS THE PLAN.... WHAT A DISGRACE AND SHAME - THERE IS NO SUCH THING AS SERVICE ANYMORE. ITS ALL A SHOW WITH NO CARE!

reviews.text: Decent enough. On a lease for Tui and operating their flights to Spain from ABZ. Crew were nice, plane was as expected.
reviews.author: Revatron

reviews.title: Failure to disclose sanitation difficiency at hotel
reviews.text: Sunwing Vacations knowingly sold and transported us to a hotel that suffered a watermain break. According to the Sunwing rep on site, the watermain break started on Saturday, 3 days before our arrival. Guests resorted to collecting water from the pool to flush their toilets. I suffered from diarrhea on day 2. I asked to be transferred to another hotel or returned to Toronto. My request was refused. Only after threatening to call the Canadian embassy and asking for an emergency evacuation were we transferred to the Grand Mutho Rainbow Hotel. This would not be the hotel of choice for my wife and I but it was far better than the situation that Sunwing placed us in. I submitted a complaint to Sunwing Cares on Feb 24, 2023 and it is now over 95 days since. Sunwing Customer Service has informed me that they have yet to investigate my claim and that it may take another 60 days or longer. Accidents happens! Responsible corporations take ownership and resolve issues such as this because it is the right and ethical thing to do. Apparently Sunwing Vacations are too busy. If you had this experience, would you travel with Sunwing again? Beware, it could happen to you.
reviews.author: Henri L

reviews.title: Stranded in Mexico
reviews.text: We booked Sunwing vacations with hotel transfer from Sunwing. My husband was on a different flight than Sunwing which arrived 10 minutes after our flight. He was at terminal 4 we were at terminal 2. Our Sunwing bus said they could not wait for him to take the airport shuttle and come to our terminal. My husband showed everyone his documentation for the Sunwing bus yet nobody would assist him to get where he needed to go. He called the Rui hotel where we were staying and they did not help him. The taxi services tried to overcharge him and brought him to the bank machine to clean out his account. A lady from a taxi service threatened him that no taxi would take him for less than $150 USD. My husband has a medical condition with a processing disorder. He was at the Cancun airport for 5 hours with everyone refusing to help him My husband said Sunwing did not have his name on their list despite his paperwork. He approached every transfer bus service. Finally he took a taxi for the large price of $100 USD. The Sunwing staff at the hotel are upset that I am not agreeing with them when they try to blame the airport. The representative at the hotel says he doesn’t want to deal with me anymore and told me to speak to someone other than himself to get us back to the airport. I do not feel safe nor supported. We went through emotional trauma and are traumatized , money comes before safety here. Travelling with small child and no way to get back to airport. Will be our last time supporting travel here. Lesson learned.

Thanks Sunwing.

reviews.title: Ridiculously Horrible Service
reviews.text: 2 hour delayed departure due to plane not being properly staffed. In flight purchase of excursion and told to book the date / time with rep at the hotel. Next morning no rep for orientation. Both myself and wonderful concierge at my resort tried all day to reach this person. Day 3finally got a reply from the CHAT in Sunwing app. That person left during conversation never to reply again and no help. Later that day my travel agent spent over an hour booking the excursion directly with NEXUS as she hot no response from Sinwing rep. 3 of us have called, texted, and left many voice mails by now. In the evening of 3rd day a whatsapp from Aneisha saying basically it looks like my problem got solved (no thanks to her for sure) but no call, no offer of assistance - NO APOLOGY for leaving me in country with no contact. Next day (vacation more than half way over now) I get whatsapp saying WELCOME TO JAMAICA!!!!???? Worst service ever. And it's certainly not the first time, just the first time it's been THIS BAD. I will be trying to avoid SUNWING 🙂
reviews.author: Melanie F

reviews.title: Embarrassing experience
reviews.text: Their online services wouldn't work so nobody could obtain their boarding pass, on top of this their "agent" who was stationed at our resort didn't have a clue; he said "yea, I am sorry, their app frequently doesn't work". At the airport they were the only airline company with a line that was packed with 4 or 5 other flights-worth of people, so things were slow moving. They did not delay any flights and forced the several hundred people to practically sprint through security to get to their flight. It was a logistical nightmare. Luckily nobody in my group was selected for searches, otherwise they would've missed our flight 100%. Being from Canada, especially the east coast, the heat caused a few of our group members to really struggle during the multiple hour wait in the line at the airport – between the heat and mad rush that was required to stay on time, this will be the last time ever I fly with Sunwing Airlines, they simply just don't care about their customers or service, and why should they when their cheaper flights will continue to attract customers trying to save money. One would expect such an airline to at least have a functioning online service and competence to schedule flights in a timely manner. I feel very bad for all of their employees, and all future customers they have.

reviews.text: I would like to say we had great service and arrived on time to mexico and back. Our luggage wasn't lost and all was great. The only complaint I do have and I was willing to pay. But there were no on board meals. I used to get the wrap or pizza on board and have some options to buy food. Now it's just snack boxes. And also what happened to the complimentary pop and beverages. Now it's just coffee tea or water is free. The least you can offer is free beverages. Sometimes flights occur on times where you could have the need to count on food being on the plane. We left the resort at 1230 and didn't arrive home till 2 am. Only options were a measly snack box. Yes there is food at the airport but at a cost of $20 at pvr for a burger and fries. At least toronto has timmies and other cheaper options. But I suggest you bring back more options on planes. I didn't even see the option of ordering ahead before departure.

I asked the representative doing our families check in 2 times to make sure our bags were checked to Edmonton as the plane also stopped in Calgary he told me twice that yes they were but of coarse when we got to Edmonton our 4 pieces of luggage did not arrive we filled out the lost baggage form at the airport and we’re told we would be called 20 hours later haven’t heard a word and Sunwing has no phone number to call to speak to a human being and their online luggage tracking is completely useless and there is no way to contact one of their representatives Sunwing customer service is completely non existent very very very unhappy with Sunwing

reviews.author: Y L

reviews.title: Very bad experience *buyers beware*
reviews.text: Part 1 We decided to travel with sunwing because of the direct flight, flight times and smile resorts despite not so hot reviews. I was traveling with my 4 year old with ASD as a single mom, with my single mom friend and her two kids. The smile resort where kids stay "free" was next to impossible to find. Which was disappointing. It's hard spending full adult prices for a 4 year old. They don't eat as much and do not drink. They are like a half an adult so should be half the price or less. This was frustrating while booking however we still decided to book. First person I booked through was wonderful however all other communications when I needed to change my reservation and get suggestions on other resorts was terrible. Incredibly rude, unhelpful and awful customer service. That should have been a red flag. Our flight left Moncton at 10 AM April 27 as scheduled. As we left our flight was only briefly in the air until it hit a bird that went into the engine and they decided to stop in Halifax. We waited patiently to hear that the verdict was and they decided to deplane us. They told us to sit by the gate until there was updates. It took a while before we found anything out. There was no seating for us near the gate so when they made announcements we couldn't hear her and she didn't use the microphone. We had to go up and ask after. She advised us that they still weren't sure of the situation, after an hour we were then advised that our plane will not be going anywhere and we need to retrieve our luggage in a couple hours as we were switching planes and we'll have to check in all over again. At this point they didn't know if there would even be another plane. Panic setting in as we anticipated this vacation so badly. After a while we were advised Flight was only going out around 8PM. 9 hours entertaining 3 kids, me carrying two suitcases and 2 personal items on my own. They offered a $20 voucher per person for food. Which is nor enough for being in an airport for 8 plus hours. So we spent money we didn't plan on spending. I was advised that we can submit a claim from the sunwing employee and we tried, and of course sunwing says we are not eligible as it was out of their control or safety concern. Whichever excuse they can weasel their way out of compensation legally. While I understand it's out of their control but not my problem. I'm a customer spending a lot of money on a very short vacation as it is and don't deserve to lose out. We only arrived at 3am(5AM Atl time) Cancun time when we were supposed to be arriving at 1:30pm. We lost an entire day of our vacation and that exciting vibe of showing up in the day and getting the full experience in the daylight. Truly we lost more than a day trying to get my child caught up from sleep he missed, he was so dysregulated from this. It was so disappointing. It took an extreme amount of time to get him on track, he even caught an awful bug from the lack of sleep/stress. I mean Sunwing didn't even offer a free snack on the flight for all our trouble which is bizarre to me. So that's part 1. Part 2 Our departure flight on the same vacation was to leave Cancun Airport at 2:40 pm. Our transfer bus picked us up at 9:45am. We were to arrive in moncton at 9:20 pm. Once we arrive at the airport we get packed in like sardines to the check in line. It was moving along quite nicely and then all of sudden stopped. No one was moving. An hour goes by and we're all so confused. Not one staff member came over to explain what was going on. Like we just are stuck in line sitting on the cold, dirty floors surrounded by 100 plus people waiting. We heard through word of mouth the system went down. But why didn't we hear anything from sunwing employees? Why didn't we get notifications on our phone through text? We had no internet in the airport, no way to contact anyone. It was awful. Again with 3 kids, 2 with disabilities. We sat on the floor in line with no meals for 6 hours. Our kids were starving. We n
reviews.author: Sunny

reviews.title: Promoting Covid
reviews.text: There was construction at the Toronto airport at Terminal 3 for the Sunwing gate. So passengers were shuttled from Terminal 3 out to a different temporary gate about 6 or 7 minutes away from the Terminal. It wasn't bad being shuttled to the temporary gate as there were only a few passengers on the shuttle. But after we returned from our trip and were shuttled back to the main terminal. Sunwing crammed an ENTIRE PLANE full of passengers onto ONE SHUTTLE for the return drive to the Terminal. There were some people wearing masks who didn't want to board the crowded shuttle but the driver told them there was no choice as there would only be one shuttle trip for A WHOLE PLANE FULL OF PASSENGERS. It was like those videos you see of the Tokyo subway cars where people are packed into the subway cars like sardines. People were literally on top of one another. If anyone on the shuttle had Covid, Sunwing made it very clear they didn't care as they would ensure that it would be spread. Like Really how much would it have cost Sunwing to have another shuttle trip?........CHEAP....CHEAP....CHEAP. Toronto Board of Health should be looking into these guys.......I know I will NEVER fly with this outfit again.
reviews.author: Shag428

reviews.title: Absolutely Terrible Airline
reviews.text: What a terrible airline. They delayed the flight 5 hours without any notification but was able to send me a gate change without any issue. There is always something with this airline. If you don’t value your time and have all the patience in the world to deal with delays on the regular and terrible service than look no further Sunwing is the airline for you. I will only fly with Air Canada or WestJet from now on
reviews.author: MarkJ

reviews.title: Never again
reviews.text: We will never ever trust Sunwing ( should be called Suckwing) for our travel needs. To make a long story short they cost us our first full day at our vacation destination and refuse to accept responsibility blaming it on weather related delays. There were no weather issues that day or the day before and we have an email from them stating the delay was because the flight crew they intended to use was not able to be utilized. After multiple emails back and forth they claim they met their obligation because they got us there within 48 hours of the original time..,, 48 hours, are you kidding me? Never again Sunwing NEVER AGAIN!!!!
reviews.author: Brian H

reviews.title: Travelling was as great as my vacation stay
reviews.text: When I travel with Sunwing, I always upgrade to elite. $100 return is worth the perks! -book seat in advance -extra luggage weight -front row(s) seating -extra leg room -short elite check-in line up -luggage off first I may have travelled during a less busy time of day, lucky for me I guess.... No line up to check in-, no line up for security. My bag was always first off at both destinations. Sunwing notifications are prompt & thorough. Email & text Crew was great and provided great customer service! Return flight, sick passenger. Both the staff and fellow passengers were very supportive and accommodating.
reviews.author: cereardon

reviews.title: BAG CHECK IN TOOK FOREVER.
reviews.text: Super nice to have the first checked bag free however the line to check in your bags in literally ate out our whole morning. We waited in line for almost two hours. We finally got our baggage checked at 7:40 which was almost a half hour past our boarding time and only 20 min until take off at 8. We still caught out plane however the situation made our day extremely stressful and because the line we were not able to ate before boarding. The many others in line were also very unnecessarily stressed out! Do better.
reviews.author: Larissa L

reviews.text: I rather not to fly than use Sunwing again.... Over 10 hrs of delay Lack of communication Parked on the tarmac for an additional hr after landing
reviews.author: Jozsef H

reviews.title: Trip to Cayo Santa Maria was a nightmare.
reviews.text: The trip was supposed to start on December 21. I was delayed three times left on the 22nd we lost the day….. During the trip, the Hôtel lost all water services three times. Returned from the trip, promised a ““ right to fly partial refund….. still waiting for two out of three. Sunwing only has telephone extensions for people that will bring them new money. Any post flight customer service must be emails on their website. This is the worst experience I’ve had over 30 years.
reviews.author: Mark S

reviews.title: STAY AWAY!!!!
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible experience. On our flight back from Cancun, there was a 50min delay, which in itself was not terrible, but we were then forced to land in Hamilton because the pilots were at risk of exceeding their flight time allowance (literally 10 min flight time from Toronto, YYZ). Management is absolutely rubbish to allow this to happen; de-planing us at Hamilton to get new pilots caused an additional 3 hour delay, which was unbearable for many travellers, especially those with young children like ourselves. We were advised that we could leave on our own and Sunwing would compensate us for our out-of-pocket expenses but so far all claims have been denied. Needless to say, I will never travel with Sunwing and I would strongly recommend travellers to consider alternate providers.
reviews.author: Jasper A

reviews.title: Horrible customer service
reviews.text: I called the customer service number to help me clarify a few things on the deceleration forms that needed to be filled out online. I was met with snide responses and laughter. It was honestly so embarrassing for me, as I just didn’t want to mess anything up and she was making me feel like I was stupid for calling. Then when I called again because my booking Number wasn’t working for me to log into my account, the man I was speaking with was so short and rude. I honestly can’t believe they are still in business with how they treat thier customers. I will never book with them again.
reviews.author: Nicole S

reviews.title: Never again, lack of support, disorganized, damaged baggage
reviews.text: Very poor communications when changes made, hard to contact anyone about damaged luggage, (still trying, no luck), misrepresentation from what they advertise and what you get when arrive. Payed $50.00 to upgrade/choose seats. Disappointed.
reviews.author: Dorothy S

reviews.title: AVOID AT ALL COSTS
reviews.text: Absolutely HORRIBLE!!!!. I booked a 10 day vacation, I will be lucky if I'll get 8 day vacation now. 40 day before departure, they already changed my trip 3 times. Lost day 1 - was supposed to get to the resort around lunch time, now it is around 11pm. Lost last day - departure was supposed to be in the evening, now it is 1st thing in the morning. 2 days are gone from the vacation. Customer service DOES NOT exist with this airline. They just use that others don't offer vacations at this time of the year. AVOID AT ALL COSTS!!!!!
reviews.author: Diana H
